item.stem:
The diagram shows point $P$, line $L$, and points $F$ and $Q$ on $L$. Segment $PF$ meets $L$ at right angles. Segment $PQ$ is drawn dashed.

Which claim about the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $L$ is correct?

options.A: Point $F$ is the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $L$, and $PF$ is the shortest segment from $P$ to $L$.
options.B: Segment $PQ$ is the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $L$.
options.C: Every segment from $P$ to a point on $L$ is a perpendicular projection onto $L$.
options.D: Point $F$ is the projection of $P$ onto $L$ only because $F$ is labelled on $L$.
